standard_prerequisites.name: Etale composition stability
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms and Spaces lemmas composition-etale, composition-representable-transformations-property, morphism-schemes-gives-representable-transformation-property (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes U_i -> X etale in (1) implies (2).

standard_prerequisites.name: Images of etale morphisms are open
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Properties of Spaces, lemma etale-image-open (cross-chapter, named)

core_obligations: (1) implies (2): the compositions U_i -> X_i -> X are etale; U_i x_X U_i = U_i x_{X_i} U_i makes both projections quasi-compact.

(2) implies (1): let X_i be the open image of |U_i| -> |X|; U_i -> X_i is surjective etale; the projections agree with those over X, hence are quasi-compact; conclude U_i -> X_i quasi-compact by the representability lemma.
proof_roadmap: Composition stability; open-image reduction; quasi-compactness transfer.
difficulty_reason: A two-direction characterization whose content is the agreement of the two fibre products over X and over X_i.
